A tier-1 European operator — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 21-person team over 14 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Retention offers fired monthly on campaign calendars; intent signals ignored in-quarter.
Network telemetry underused; NOC reactive to customer complaints.
Voice care deflected without resolving; cost per contact climbing.

blocks.x: The save hub on Nexus triggers personalized offers from support tickets, usage drops and billing disputes within policy; the telemetry backbone on Forge unified probes, elements and tickets for predictive ops; and resolution-first voice AI grounded on the policy corpus now resolves top intents with context-preserving escalation.
A tier-1 European operator uses the standard Achala delivery pattern — nothing bespoke about the governance, everything bespoke about the design. That split is deliberate.
